K4｜PENDING_ACCEPTANCE｜传统体系证据分层
证据分层｜事实不改名，古籍不越界

同一产品案例把 depthmapX 与 Radiance 的可复现结果、古籍文本、现代解释假设和未验证主张分开保存。 K2 与 K3 的几何连续性当前明确为 NOT_PROVEN，因此禁止跨引擎因果推断。

证据分层产物已读入。 7 条记录｜K2/K3 geometry continuity=NOT_PROVEN｜跨层等同默认 BLOCK。
现代计算事实｜F-K2-01｜depthmapX reference output

depthmapX 0.9.1 VGA local visibility produced 263 points with mean Connectivity 124.8, minimum 65 and maximum 200.

允许：Report the stored spatial-analysis result.
禁止：Do not rename Connectivity as qi, fortune, health, or life outcome.

现代计算事实｜F-K3-01｜Radiance reference output

Radiance 6.0.2 produced 20 workplane illuminance values: mean 771.6 lx, minimum 421.2 lx, maximum 1976.2 lx, near-window mean 1049.2 lx and deep-zone mean 494.0 lx.

允许：Report the point-in-time modeled illuminance distribution.
禁止：Do not claim annual daylight performance, user-home measurement, qi, or auspiciousness.

传统文本证据｜T-K4-01｜《宅经》住宅论述

The received text treats the dwelling as a distinct object of traditional judgement.

夫宅者，乃是陰陽之樞紐，人倫之軌模。

来源：《宅经》卷上（题《黄帝宅经》）｜归属/传承：TRADITIONALLY_ATTRIBUTED; AUTHORSHIP_NOT_TREATED_AS_PROVEN

允许：Show that a residential interpretive tradition exists and preserve its own vocabulary.
禁止：The passage does not validate any numerical daylight, visibility, health, wealth, or event prediction.

传统文本证据｜T-K4-02｜《葬书》风与水语句

The received text links dispersal with wind and stopping with water in a burial/site-selection discourse.

氣乘風則散，界水則止。

来源：《葬书》｜归属/传承：ATTRIBUTION_TO_GUO_PU_DISPUTED_IN_RECEIVED_BIBLIOGRAPHIC_NOTICE

允许：Describe the wording and its burial/landscape scope.
禁止：Do not equate wind with Radiance, water with depthmapX, or extend burial claims to indoor residential outcomes.

传统文本证据｜T-K4-03｜二十四山名称与次序

The frozen source supports names, composition and cyclic order used by the direction normalizer.


来源：《欽定協紀辨方書》卷二｜frozen facsimile leaf/PDF 5-7｜归属/传承：IMPERIALLY_COMPILED_RECEIVED_TEXT

允许：Normalize a measured azimuth into a named 24-mountain sector under the product's explicit 15-degree engineering convention.
禁止：The source binding does not authorize environmental, causal or auspiciousness conclusions.

现代解释假设｜H-K4-01｜南窗与采光梯度的现代解释

For the K3 model inputs, distance from the south window is associated with a modeled illuminance gradient.

允许：Explain the K3 model output under its stated geometry and sky.
禁止：Do not treat this as proof of a traditional south-facing rule or as a result for another dwelling.

未验证主张｜U-K4-01｜现代指标等同气或吉凶

Connectivity or illuminance directly measures qi, auspiciousness, health, wealth, or future events.

允许：Display only as a blocked claim requiring independent evidence and an operational definition.
禁止：Do not use in recommendations or status decisions.

规则：计算事实必须附引擎、产物和适用范围；传统文本必须附作品、见证版本、归属/传承状态和原始语境； 任何“Connectivity/lux＝气/吉凶/健康/财富/未来”的等同主张默认阻断。
